reviews.text: this pallete did not show up on my skin and the fallout was terrible, it kept getting in my eyes when trying to apply and didnt even show up after lots of product on my face, thought the glitters are nice, they are subtle if you are into that
reviews.zh: 呢盒眼影喺我塊面完全冇顯色，飛粉仲勁到不得了，化嘅時候成日跌入晒眼，落咗好多產品上面都仲係唔顯色。不過啲亮片幾靚，如果你鍾意嗰種低調嘅感覺就啱。

reviews.text:
This is my favorite Wakemake eye palette. I love the burgundy browns and reds, and they looks so good with my eye color. I use this palette weekly. 

I admit, I originally only purchased this palette because I'm a fan of Squid Games. But this palette exceeded all my expectations. I love it so much! Great colors and can do subtle burgundy looks or bold smokey eyes. I like to use the dark brown shade in this palette for eye liner.

I love the Wakemake eye palettes. Each palette has a variety of colors and shades, and I can make so many different looks with the same palette. There are plenty of matte shades to use as a base and contour, and there is also shimmer shades that work great as toppers and/or detail work.
reviews.zh:
呢盒係我最鍾意嘅 Wakemake 眼影盤。我超鍾意入面嘅酒紅棕同紅色，襯起我雙眼嘅顏色超靚。我每星期都會用呢盒眼影。

我承認，本來我買呢盒眼影只係因為我係《魷魚遊戲》嘅粉絲。但呢盒眼影完全超乎我預期。我超級鍾意！顏色靚，可以化低調酒紅妝，亦可以化大膽煙燻眼妝。我鍾意用呢盒入面嘅深啡色嚟做眼線。

我好鍾意 Wakemake 嘅眼影盤。每一盒都有好多唔同嘅顏色同色調，單用一盒已經可以化出好多唔同嘅妝。有好多霧面色可以做底色同輪廓，亦有好多閃爍色用嚟做 highlight 同／或者細節都好好用。

reviews.text: The colors are so pretty and unique! Definitely has the mermaid and beach vibes! You just have to make sure that the makeup base is neutral(not yellow) or the blue shades might appear green(unless that’s what you’re going for!) You might need to double dip into some of the lighter colors to see more pay off but it doesn’t clump or stick in the eyelid creases! I haven’t really experimented with the beige colors that much but the shimmers and pearls are definitely impeccable! Truly a fun palette to spice up your makeup look with!
reviews.zh: 啲顏色真係好靚好特別！完全有人魚同沙灘嘅感覺！一定要確保底妝係中性色（唔係偏黃），否則啲藍色調望落可能會變綠（除非你想嘅效果就係咁！）。有啲淺色可能要多重沾取先至有更明顯嘅顯色度，但又唔會結塊或者黐住眼皮摺位！其實我都未試過好多嗰啲米色調，但啲閃粉同珠光色真係無懈可擊！真係一盒用嚟令妝容更有趣嘅眼影盤！

reviews.text:
The blues apply really smoothly, no patchiness. This brand makes my favorite glitter eyeshadows. They never have fallout, and look the same on the lids as they do in the pan.
I own lots of Wakemake palettes, but this one just feels better quality. The mattes don’t have as much fallout and are not as chalky, even the pale shades. I wonder if they improved the formula for their newer releases?
I still wouldn’t say this is pigmented enough for high-glam or cosplay makeup. Better suited for daily wear.
reviews.zh:
啲藍色上色好順滑，完全冇斑駁。呢個品牌出嘅閃粉眼影係我最鍾意嘅，完全唔會飛粉，眼上面嘅效果同眼影盤入面望落一模一樣。
我自己擁有好幾盒 Wakemake 眼影盤，但呢盒感覺質素更加好。啲霧面嘅飛粉冇咁嚴重，亦冇咁粉感，連淺色都係。我都唔知係咪佢哋新出嘅款式改良咗配方？
但我都唔會話佢夠顯色去化高調 glam 或者 cosplay 妝。比較適合日常返工返學用。

reviews.text:
Initially I thought the design was cool, but now I don’t like the split pans. They are already small. Why cut them in half? The purple and green don’t look good mixed together, so I must use them separately. 
The lime colors are not intense, so they are suitable for casual wear. I’ve had difficulty with this looking patchy when there are any other “wet” products on my eyelids. Otherwise they are ok. The mattes are a little dusty but the glitters adhere well and are not messy. 
Overall kind of annoying to work with, but looks nice when done right.
reviews.zh:
一開始我覺得個設計幾特別，但而家我唔鍾意啲分格。本來已經細，點解仲要切開兩半？紫色同綠色溝埋一齊唔好睇，所以要分開用。
嗰啲青檸色唔算好濃郁，啱平時 casual 著衫用。如果眼皮上面有任何其他「濕」嘅產品，呢盒眼影就好易化到斑駁。否則嘅話都算 ok。啲霧面少少粉感重，但閃粉貼得好實又唔會黐到周圍都係。
整體嚟講用起上嚟有少少煩，但要化得好其實出嚟效果幾靚。

reviews.text: Lovely autumn slightly warmer brown palette. It’s so nice and has a nice mix of shades. Shadows are buttery soft and apply and blend easily. Downside are repetitive shades, especially in palette 12. London Brown is personally my favourite out of the two new palettes as it’s not as repetitive as palette 12. The freebie mini blush is cute too. Applies lightly and is buildable
reviews.zh: 好靚嘅秋日感、稍為暖調嘅啡色眼影盤。超正，色調配搭幾好。眼影質地好滑順，上色同推開都好容易。缺點係有啲色重複咗，尤其係 12 號嗰盒。London Brown 係兩盒新眼影盤入面我最鍾意嗰盒，因為冇 12 號嗰盒咁多重複色。跟機送嘅迷你胭脂都好得意，上色自然，亦都可以層叠加重。

reviews.text:
I wasn’t the biggest fan of the older version of these palettes but I saw candy blurring and just HAD to get it!
The colors are so pretty and it has become my favorite palette but the one thing is that some of the colors are basically the same colors so there isn’t that much variety despite being a 16 color palette but nevertheless I love it
The color payoff is also amazing and there is barely any powder fallout
reviews.zh:
我本來對呢個系列舊版嘅眼影盤唔算最有興趣，但一見到 candy blurring 就忍唔住即刻要買！
啲顏色真係超靚，佢已經變咗我最鍾意嘅眼影盤，但有一點係有啲顏色基本上差唔多，所以雖然有 16 色但都唔算好多變化，不過我依然好鍾意。
顯色度都好厲害，幾乎完全冇飛粉。

reviews.text:
I've wanted to try the renewed Wakemake palette for a while now, so when I saw how gorgeous the colour story for Candy Coral Blurring was I was sold!

The texture of this palette is just insane. The amount of fallout compared to how amazingly pigmented these shades are is so minimal, it's incredible! Everything is so silky and blendable on top of only needing 1 application to really express the colour. 

There's a great variety of mattes, matte pearls, shimmers and glitters. I was especially impressed by all the gorgeous shimmers. Only thing I would have wanted is one more glitter shade that is a bit more fancy, since the one in the palette while beautiful is pretty subtle. Otherwise though, the composition of the palette is amazing and it allows for such a huge variety of looks from orange coral to pink coral to coral brown and more.

The eye primer from the set is super creamy and works really well as a blush!

I highly highly recommend this palette.
reviews.zh:
我好耐之前就想試 Wakemake 改良版嘅眼影盤，所以當我見到 Candy Coral Blurring 嘅配色咁靚嘅時候即刻被吸引！

呢盒眼影盤嘅質地真係冇得彈。對比佢哋嘅顯色度，飛粉嘅量真係少得離譜，好神奇！所有顏色都好絲滑好易推開，只需要沾一次已經可以完全帶出顏色。

霧面、霧面珠光、閃粉同亮片嘅配搭好豐富。嗰啲閃粉真係令我印象特別深刻。唯一我想要多啲嘅係多一隻比較特別嘅閃粉色，因為入面嗰隻雖然靚但比較低調。不過除此之外，呢盒眼影盤嘅配色真係好正，可以化到好多唔同嘅妝，由橙色珊瑚到粉紅珊瑚到珊瑚啡等等都做到。

set 內附嘅眼霜 primer 好 creamy，用嚟做胭脂都好好用！

我極度極度推薦呢盒眼影盤。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
